title: Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.16804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility

translated_title: 跨手语迁移学习：基于多尺度时间对齐的域自适应方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16804v1 公告类型：新 摘要：手语是听力障碍人士的重要沟通方式，然而，对超过100种不同手语的识别资源严重匮乏。为此，我们提出了利用迁移学习和域自适应方法TA3N进行手语识别的工作，该方法采用时间关系网络（TRN）模块来对齐多尺度时间关系。我们的研究结果强调了域自适应相对于基于神经网络的迁移学习的优越性能，特别是在提高美国手语（ASL）识别方面。我们的研究还确定了在源域和目标域之间对齐较短时间特征的有效性。除了使用RGB外，我们还对手语样本进行了光流模式实验，最终确定在大多数情况下RGB优于光流。我们的工作旨在提高可访问性。
tldr: 本文提出使用域自适应方法TA3N结合多尺度时间对齐，显著提升跨手语识别性能，尤其在美国手语上优于传统迁移学习，并发现RGB特征比光流更有效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a domain adaptation method TA3N with multi-scale temporal alignment, significantly improving cross-sign language recognition, especially for American Sign Language, and finds RGB features outperform optical flow in most cases.
